version: V20 A5 (Ryō, 2026-10-18): A4's gated cut-4 route with a stable end of training, toward the LTWS β
question: Does A4's content-gated cut-4 route meet lane A's flip endpoint in every seed when its learning rate decays over the second half of training, instead of being scored under a constant rate?
data_checks: the sealed records' data hashes and row alignment; no new extraction

rendering.check: both sides render the same prompt (V15 LiveStore)

memory.encoding: memory and question each run alone through the layers below the cut (engine DecoderHost.to_cut); the memory's states enter as positions before the question's and the host continues (engine CutPrefixRoute)
memory.cut_zero: at cut 0 the memory is its text as a prefix; checked bitwise against the inline forward on sampled rows

ladder.run: V20 A2 depth ladder: sealed 1daa358d0a745fc71baa62aefef3c9858dc1920b, plan 295392251ca596e55997bf8ada4ec530ce6ac6ac46af5bfc7eb6db1d4231ecd1, verified locally and on Furnace
ladder.relative_to: this run's raw folder; the task roots sit side by side under tmp/ on Furnace
ladder.reused: the cut-4 train rows (each side's own facts) and final rows (every condition), the host's scores and the ungated route's final scores

a4.run: V20 A4 content-gated cut-4 route: sealed 6bf97c24133dea7eb5a786c64697de184832d85c, plan 1f4de6c04e83389671c65e0928c80bf89d0d08363c41e82c325e34bd4daa6ddc, verified locally and on Furnace
a4.reused: the 4,096 mismatch rows, the gated route's final scores, and seed 1's update receipts

mismatch.definition: for each train row (world w, question q, side s): the facts of another training world on side s that do not name both entities of question q, so they do not answer it
mismatch.rule: the first o = (w + stride * k) mod 256, k = 1, 2, ..., whose six names (metadata.orders[0]) do not include both names of metadata.query_pairs[q]
mismatch.why_not_both: the name pool has 12 names and a world uses 6, so 23% of plain (w + 97) mod 256 memories name both entities and state an answer
mismatch.rows: one per train row, in the ladder's train row order: final states at the question positions and the host's candidate logits, as the ladder's extraction
mismatch.checks: every parity_every-th row: the head on the final states equals the decoder continued from the cut, and the row re-read with its own memory equals the ladder's stored features, bitwise

gating.penalty: weight x the mean square of the route's two-candidate residual on the mismatch rows of each update's batch
gating.never_trained_on: lane A's random-pair control, the dev split and the final split
gating.choice: development checks on train worlds only (provenance/pilots/v20_a4_gated_route_20261017/DEV_CHECKS.md)

route.composition: latent_workspace.composition.DeliberationRoute (D1's route) over the question-position final states; gated low-rank residual on the host's logits
route.initialization: per-component derived seeds; the route and readout of one seed share every common parameter

arm_definitions.host: the frozen host's own answer with the memory at cut 4 (the ladder's); no training
arm_definitions.stable: A4's gated route with the learning rate decaying after update 256
arm_definitions.gated: comparator: A4's gated route (constant learning rate), from its pinned scores
arm_definitions.ungated: comparator: the ladder's route at cut 4, from its pinned scores
arm_definitions.ensemble: descriptive: the mean of the three stable seeds' candidate logits

training.objective: choice-normalized cross-entropy over the two candidates at the last prompt position
training.schedule: constant 3e-4 to update 256, then linear decay: lr(step) = 3e-4 x (513 - step) / 257 for step > 256, reaching 1.2e-6 at update 512 (engine training.learning_rate_at)
training.randomness: data order per epoch, dropout and loss sampling per update, all derived from (seed, step)
training.rows: the ladder's 4,096 train rows (both sides x 8 questions x 256 worlds), each with its own facts; every update also reads the same batch rows with their mismatch memory

endpoints.verdict: stable: CONTENT_REACHES_ANSWERS if every seed reaches it, DIRECTIONAL_ONLY if every seed is at least directional, otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED (the ladder's per-arm rule)
endpoints.comparison: per seed against A4's gated route and the ladder's ungated route: verdict, flips, random-pair flips, accuracy and the gap moved from the host's under each condition (descriptive)

beta_candidate.rule: if the primary verdict is CONTENT_REACHES_ANSWERS, the stable route of this seed is the LTWS β candidate and the other seeds are replicates; fixed before launch so that no seed is chosen on the final split. Publication remains Ryō's separate decision.

reproduce.why: A4's gated route of seed 1, retrained here from the pinned records: equal receipts, fingerprint and scores show that the comparison with A4 differs only by the learning rate

replay.why: update 257 is the first with a decayed learning rate

process_policy: each role a fresh process through scripts/run_source_sealed.py, in order, stopping at the first failure
scope: Frozen backbone. The verdict says whether this system (frozen host plus the stable gated route) answers held-out questions from a memory written at cut 4, on this task family, in every seed. It is not a claim about memory moving the native head, general reasoning, non-regression or language quality, and it is not a release decision.
